strategy.name: nasdaq100_strategy1_energy_level_direction_forward_return_anatomy
strategy.description: 在1999-03-10至2026-08-04的滞后一交易日历史Nasdaq-100成分中，对每只证券重新运行冻结且未经调参的Strategy1母状态，并把完成Close后的股票仓位比例称为能量。研究不做Top20、不构造共享资本轮动账户，也不按结果修改42/100周期或任何母策略规则；它把每个证券日按能量水平、五个交易日前后的能量方向以及高能量穿越状态分类。每个可执行观察在信号Close后的下一真实Open开始，用独立1美元事件账户观察未来5/10/20/60个XNYS交易日的证券收益、同期QQQ超额收益、最大有利涨幅和最大不利回撤。结果同时报告日等权、证券等权、逐日横截面Rank IC、五个时期和按月区块自助置信区间，用来判断能量究竟是可排序因子、只适合门禁，还是只是过去交易路径的状态记录。历史成分与个股行情仍为pending_review候选数据，所有结论只作探索。
strategy.buy_rule: 本研究没有共享资金组合。对每个当日按一XNYS交易日滞后口径已知为Nasdaq-100成分、当日有真实完成Close和有限Strategy1能量的security_id，在下一XNYS交易日仅当该证券存在真实非合成Open时建立一个互相独立、名义本金1美元的观察事件；不能成交的观察被明确排除并计数，不延期到更晚Open。
strategy.sell_rule: 每个事件分别在信号日后的第5、10、20或60个XNYS交易日Close结束观察；若证券在目标日前已经到达最后真实供应商交易日，则按最后真实Close终止并标记为终止截短。内部缺栏只允许用已知Close作期末估值并单独标记，不能伪造新的买入。事件之间不共享份额、现金或退出决定。
strategy.signal_time: Strategy1能量、能量五日方向、历史自身252日百分位和高能量状态只使用当日完成Close及更早信息；成员身份使用滞后一XNYS交易日后可观察的历史时点状态。
strategy.execution_time: 能量在交易日Close确认，标准化事件从下一XNYS交易日真实调整Open开始，在预声明期限的调整Close或更早的最后真实Close结束；分别应用单边0或5bps不利冲击。
strategy.positioning: 每条证券日与每个期限都是独立的1美元归一化事件账户，不融资、不做空、现金不计息；重叠事件可以同时存在，因为本实验测量条件未来收益而不是声称可交易组合CAGR。

plain_language.summary: 检查个股的Strategy1能量高低和升降，是否真的对应之后更强的上涨，而不是先做轮动再猜原因。
plain_language.buy: 某只当时属于纳指成分的股票在收盘后得到能量状态，下一交易日有真实开盘价时才从该开盘开始观察。
plain_language.sell: 每条观察分别在未来5、10、20或60个交易日结束，若股票更早停止真实交易就按最后真实收盘结束并注明。
plain_language.execution: 所有能量在收盘后确认，未来收益从下一真实开盘计算，绝不使用同一收盘提前成交。
plain_language.position: 每个股票日期独立按1美元归一化，不组成共享账户；同时与同日期的QQQ未来收益比较。

signal_engine.score: post-trade Strategy1 equity weight in the security at completed Close
signal_engine.parameter_optimization: none; recompute the full 0-to-1 score surface with the frozen parent engine because the validated parent cache retained only scores strictly above 0.90

energy_direction.rising: current score exceeds the score five XNYS sessions earlier by more than tolerance
energy_direction.flat: absolute five-session score change is no greater than tolerance
energy_direction.falling: current score is below the score five XNYS sessions earlier by more than tolerance

high_energy_states.cross_above: previous completed score no greater than 0.90 and current completed score strictly greater than 0.90
high_energy_states.persistent: current and the previous five completed XNYS-session scores are all strictly greater than 0.90
high_energy_states.cross_below: previous completed score strictly greater than 0.90 and current completed score no greater than 0.90

own_history_percentile.definition: causal percentile rank of the current score among the same security's trailing 252 completed score observations including current Close; at least 126 observations are required

parameters.entry_definition: signal Close at t; adjusted Open at XNYS session t+1 must be a real non-synthetic non-prelisting non-terminal bar
parameters.exit_definition: adjusted Close at XNYS session t+h; if the security's last real vendor session occurs earlier, end at that last real Close and flag terminal truncation
parameters.internal_missing_close_policy: a carried adjusted Close may mark the requested horizon and is flagged synthetic; it cannot establish an event entry

aggregation.primary_weighting: each signal date receives equal weight after averaging securities within date and energy group

bootstrap.unit: calendar month block of daily cross-sectional aggregates

diagnostic_spreads: score strictly above 0.90 minus score no greater than 0.90

financing: not applicable to independent normalized events; no event borrows or shorts
benchmark: Each security event is matched to QQQ from the same next-session adjusted Open to the security event's same actual ending session under the same cost scenario; a terminal-truncated security event therefore uses the same shorter interval for QQQ. Daily cross-sectional excess return is the primary outcome.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse the shared v5 renderer. Add factor-specific energy-bucket curves, state-transition comparisons, era heatmaps, daily Rank IC, bootstrap confidence intervals and sample-availability diagnostics; do not present overlapping event returns as portfolio equity or CAGR.

research.hypothesis: If the Strategy1 position score is a genuine cross-sectional energy factor rather than only a path-dependent record, higher scores should be associated with stronger future matched-QQQ returns, the relation should be broadly monotonic and positive across eras, and high energy that is rising should outperform high energy that is falling.
research.primary_metric: At zero cost, for 5/10/20/60-session horizons report date-equal market-adjusted returns by the seven frozen energy buckets, daily cross-sectional raw-score and causal-own-percentile Rank IC, high-versus-not-high and E99_100-versus-E90_95 spreads, plus high-rising-versus-high-falling spreads. Require pooled, date-equal and security-equal signs, five-era stability, month-block 95% intervals, event availability, terminal truncation and 5bps sensitivity.
research.selection_rule: Run the full frozen score surface and every predeclared bucket, direction, state, horizon, era and cost. Do not tune 42/100, bucket boundaries, direction lookback, 90% threshold, horizons, bootstrap seed or minimum cross-section after viewing results. Do not select securities or report only favorable buckets.
research.validation_plan: Regression-test the frozen Strategy1 fast score against its reference, strict bucket boundaries, one-session-lag membership, Close-to-next-real-Open timing, terminal truncation, future path excursions, causal rolling percentile, direction/state classification, daily Rank IC and deterministic month-block bootstrap. Reconcile a vectorized event engine against an independent per-security loop within 1e-10; because observations are independent overlapping event accounts rather than a shared tradable portfolio, PyBroker portfolio CAGR is deliberately not produced. Then run full tests, report tests, real Chrome, PDF, catalog, workspace and validate_run.
research.promotion_criteria: This diagnostic cannot directly promote a portfolio while data is pending_review. Raw-score ranking is supported only if 10/20/60-session mean daily Rank IC are positive and at least two horizons are positive in at least four of five eras with pooled and security-equal signs agreeing. The 90% gate is supported only if high-minus-not-high is positive at at least two of 10/20/60 sessions, its month-block 95% lower bound is above zero for at least one, and at least four eras share the sign. Direction is supported only if high-rising minus high-falling is positive at at least two of 10/20/60 sessions with at least one positive lower bound. Any supported component must later enter a separately frozen turnover-aware portfolio test with approved data.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject claims based on current constituents, same-Close entry, per-security parameter fitting, omitted low-score observations, score histories that use future values, events entered on synthetic/prelisting/terminal bars, hidden terminal truncation, pooled rows presented without date/security-equal alternatives, naive independent-event standard errors, fewer than all five eras, selecting only favorable horizons, treating overlapping normalized events as a capital-feasible portfolio, reconciliation above 1e-10, or language presenting pending_review candidate data as approved evidence.
